app.title: What's New in PHP 8.6
app.description: Official release of PHP 8.6, a server‑side scripting language with new features and performance improvements.
proposed_tests: Download PHP 8.6 source, compile and run `php -v`.
Execute a simple script `<?php echo 'hello'; ?>` via CLI and web server.
Measure compile time and execution time for a benchmark script.
Run `php -r "var_dump(PHP_VERSION);"` and verify version string matches 8.6.*
